title: 고인 하늘
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern in 4/4 time at 72 BPM. A male tenor vocal performs with a breathy, intimate delivery and light vibrato. A subtle, warm sub-bass enters during the chorus, following the root notes of the chord progression. The arrangement features a high-frequency shimmer from a digital pad in the background. The vocal is processed with a medium-length plate reverb and a subtle slapback delay. The key is E major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[breathy male vocals]
퇴근길 지하철 안에서
지도를 켰어 습관처럼
빨간 핀 하나 남아 있어
우리가 저장한 그 카페
삼월이었나 사월이었나
네가 웃으며 눌렀잖아
여기 맛있다고 별표 하나

[Chorus]
[warm sub-bass enters]
지우면 끝나는 거 알아
엄지를 올려놓았다 내려
빨간 핀이 심장 같아서
